■ When you put this creature, each player chooses one of their creatures and puts the rest of their creatures into their owner's mana zone.
■ Each turn, when one of your shields leaves your shield zone for the first time, each opponent chooses one of their shields. This may break all of the chosen shields.
■ Your opponent's creatures attack if able.
